'''Methias Yoran''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served in the [[Imperial Diplomatic Service]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. A skilled diplomat, he personally accepted the fealty of thirty worlds during his lengthy career, and was instrumental in the [[Chiss–Imperial treaty|alliance]] between the Empire and the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]]. During the Cold War, he was assigned to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]], and spent several years there attempting to secure an alliance with the native [[Voss (species)|Voss]]. [[Darth Tormen]] dispatched a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] to work with Yoran to eliminate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Thelonia Redrish]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Methias Yoran first appeared in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' by [[BioWare]] as part of the Bounty Hunter's class story on Voss. If the Hunter exclusively selects dark side options, then they can convince Ambassador Yoran to commit suicide as they leave Voss.<ref name="TOR" />
